'''T9-B2''' was a [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] used by the [[Rift Alliance]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]] it was used to transmit the hologram of [[Tai Cordan]], who assisted [[Barsen'thor]] and the [[Rift Alliance Coalition Forces]] in the planning their assault on the [[Guardian Hold Four]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
T9-B2 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Consular class mission on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
